name: list_providers
title: List providers
description: List configured model runtimes (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, Docker Model Runner, and any opt-in MLX / vLLM / Foundry Local / OpenAI-compatible / hosted instances) with host, kind (local or hosted), live status, and capabilities.

provider.description: Provider instance name. Omit to let the server choose (local providers only, unless LOCAL_AI_ALLOW_HOSTED_FALLBACK is set).

name: list_models
title: List installed models
description: List models installed/available on each live provider, keyed by provider. Pass provider to query just one.

provider.description: Provider instance name. Omit to let the server choose (local providers only, unless LOCAL_AI_ALLOW_HOSTED_FALLBACK is set).

name: list_loaded
title: List loaded models
description: List models currently loaded into memory on each live provider, with VRAM use and context length where the runtime reports them.

provider.description: Provider instance name. Omit to let the server choose (local providers only, unless LOCAL_AI_ALLOW_HOSTED_FALLBACK is set).

name: model_info
title: Model info
description: Detailed metadata for one model (family, parameter size, quantization, context length, and layer architecture where available). Without provider, queries the live local providers that have the model.

provider.description: Provider instance name. Omit to let the server choose (local providers only, unless LOCAL_AI_ALLOW_HOSTED_FALLBACK is set).

name: pull_model
title: Pull model
description: HEAVY: Download a model onto ONE provider (multiple GB, can take a long time). Streams download progress via MCP progress notifications when the client sends a progressToken. Without provider, uses the provider that already has the model, else the first live local provider that can pull.

model.description: Model id/name to pull (e.g. qwen3:8b, hf.co/<repo>:<quant>)

provider.description: Provider instance name. Omit to let the server choose (local providers only, unless LOCAL_AI_ALLOW_HOSTED_FALLBACK is set).

name: remove_model
title: Remove model
description: DESTRUCTIVE: Permanently delete a model from one provider. provider is REQUIRED (no fan-out). If the client supports elicitation the user is asked to confirm directly; otherwise confirm:true is required.

provider.description: Provider to delete from (required). Omit to let the server choose (local providers only, unless LOCAL_AI_ALLOW_HOSTED_FALLBACK is set).

confirm.description: Must be true when the client cannot ask the user directly (no elicitation support)

name: load_model
title: Load model
description: Load a model into memory on ONE provider so it is ready for inference. Optional keepAlive (e.g. '5m', '1h') and contextLength. Without provider, uses the live local provider that has the model.

keepAlive.description: How long to keep the model resident, e.g. '5m'

contextLength.description: Context window to load with (Ollama num_ctx, LM Studio --context-length)

provider.description: Provider instance name. Omit to let the server choose (local providers only, unless LOCAL_AI_ALLOW_HOSTED_FALLBACK is set).

name: unload_model
title: Unload model
description: Unload a model from memory to free VRAM/RAM on ONE provider. Without provider, uses the live local provider that has it loaded.

provider.description: Provider instance name. Omit to let the server choose (local providers only, unless LOCAL_AI_ALLOW_HOSTED_FALLBACK is set).

name: ensure_model
title: Ensure model is ready
description: Make a model ready in one call: optionally pull it, check it fits current free VRAM, unload other models if needed (evict: 'lru' or 'all'), load it, and verify. Use dryRun:true to get the plan without changing anything.

provider.description: Provider instance name. Omit to let the server choose (local providers only, unless LOCAL_AI_ALLOW_HOSTED_FALLBACK is set).

contextLength.description: Context window to fit and load with (default 4096)

kvCacheType.description: KV cache precision used for the fit estimate (default f16)

allowPull.description: Download the model if it is not installed (default false)

evict.description: Unload other models to make room: none (default), lru (least recently used first), all

keepAlive.description: Keep-alive for the loaded model, e.g. '30m'

name: health_check
title: Health check
description: Check whether each provider is reachable and report its version (and live metrics such as vLLM KV-cache usage). Without provider, checks every configured provider, including hosted ones.

provider.description: Provider instance name. Omit to let the server choose (local providers only, unless LOCAL_AI_ALLOW_HOSTED_FALLBACK is set).

name: system_resources
title: System resources
description: Report local hardware: platform, total/available RAM, CPU count, and GPUs with total/free VRAM (NVIDIA via nvidia-smi, AMD/Intel via sysfs or the Windows registry, Apple Silicon unified memory). Each GPU names its data source.

name: fit_check
title: Fit check
description: Will a model run on this machine, and where? Uses the installed model's size and exact layer architecture when the runtime exposes it (else parameter-count or catalog estimates) to size weights + KV cache for a context length, then compares with free VRAM summed across GPUs and available RAM. Returns target gpu / partial (GPU+CPU split) / cpu / none, with the numbers and how the KV estimate was made. Credits back memory the model already uses if it is loaded.

sizeBytes.description: Explicit weight size in bytes (overrides lookup)

contextLength.description: Context length for the KV-cache estimate (default 4096)

kvCacheType.description: KV cache precision: f16 (default), q8_0, q4_0

provider.description: Provider instance name. Omit to let the server choose (local providers only, unless LOCAL_AI_ALLOW_HOSTED_FALLBACK is set).

name: benchmark
title: Benchmark
description: HEAVY: Runs REAL inference. Measures a model on this machine with a warmup (absorbs load time) plus N streamed runs: time-to-first-token, generation tokens/sec (runtime-reported when available, else measured after the first token), and prompt-processing speed. Pass models[] to compare several models with the same prompt, ranked by generation speed.

models.description: Compare several models (ranked by median generation tokens/sec)

warmup.description: Run a 1-token warmup first so load time is excluded (default true)

provider.description: Provider instance name. Omit to let the server choose (local providers only, unless LOCAL_AI_ALLOW_HOSTED_FALLBACK is set).

name: search_available
title: Search catalog
description: Search the built-in curated catalog of well-known local models (Ollama tags) by name, family, or task. Offline and instant. For live results with per-quant fit, use search_models with source 'huggingface'.

query.description: Search text matched against model name, family, and tasks

name: suggest_model
title: Suggest model
description: Recommend catalog models for a task, ranked for THIS machine: fully-on-GPU first, then partial GPU offload, then CPU-only. Within a tier the largest (most capable) model comes first unless preferSpeed is true. Flags models already installed on a live provider and explains each pick.

task.description: The task you want a model for

preferSpeed.description: Prefer smaller, faster models within each tier

name: search_models
title: Search models (live)
description: Find models to download, annotated with whether each fits this machine. source 'huggingface' searches GGUF repos on the Hugging Face Hub and returns per-quant sizes, the best quant for this hardware, and pullable references (Ollama: hf.co/<repo>:<quant>). source 'catalog' searches the offline curated list. The Ollama library has no public search API, so it is not a source.

task.description: Catalog source only: filter by task

fitsOnly.description: Only return results with a quant that fits

name: complete
title: Delegated completion
description: DELEGATED INFERENCE: Offload a completion to a model you choose for cost savings and privacy. Without provider, runs on the live LOCAL provider that has the model (never a hosted API unless LOCAL_AI_ALLOW_HOSTED_FALLBACK is set); the result's 'provider', 'host' and 'local' fields say where it ran. Supports system prompts, JSON / JSON-Schema output (validated 'parsed' field), seed/topP/topK, image inputs for vision models, and contextLength for long inputs. Streams tokens via MCP progress notifications when the client sends a progressToken.

model.description: Model id/name to run the completion on

messages.description: Chat messages; content may be a string or text/image parts (vision models)

contextLength.description: Context window to run with (Ollama num_ctx). Raise it for long inputs to avoid truncation.

responseFormat.description: Constrain output to JSON (json_object) or a JSON Schema (json_schema); the result includes a validated 'parsed' value

schema.description: JSON Schema the output must satisfy

stream.description: Stream tokens (default true). Progress notifications are sent when the client provides a progressToken.

provider.description: Provider instance name. Omit to let the server choose (local providers only, unless LOCAL_AI_ALLOW_HOSTED_FALLBACK is set).

name: embed
title: Delegated embeddings
description: DELEGATED EMBEDDINGS: Generate embeddings for a string or an array of texts. Without provider, runs on the live local provider that has the model. Always returns one vector per input.

input.description: Text or array of texts to embed

provider.description: Provider instance name. Omit to let the server choose (local providers only, unless LOCAL_AI_ALLOW_HOSTED_FALLBACK is set).

name: delegate
title: Delegate a task to the best local model
description: ONE CALL to offload work locally: pick the best model for a task on THIS machine, make it ready, and run it. Prefers models already loaded (no load cost), then installed models that fit your free VRAM, then (with allowPull) the best catalog model that fits. Task specialists (coder, vision, reasoning) win over general models; larger fitting models win over smaller. Never uses a hosted provider unless allowHosted is true. Returns the completion plus a 'routing' block explaining the choice.

task.description: What kind of work this is

messages.description: Chat messages; content may be a string or text/image parts (vision models)

contextLength.description: Context window to run with (Ollama num_ctx). Raise it for long inputs to avoid truncation.

responseFormat.description: Constrain output to JSON (json_object) or a JSON Schema (json_schema); the result includes a validated 'parsed' value

schema.description: JSON Schema the output must satisfy

stream.description: Stream tokens (default true). Progress notifications are sent when the client provides a progressToken.

allowPull.description: Download a catalog model if nothing suitable is installed (default false)

provider.description: Restrict to one provider. Omit to let the server choose (local providers only, unless LOCAL_AI_ALLOW_HOSTED_FALLBACK is set).
